01_pre_shift_planning.existingProcess: Sandline reviews the heat forecast, work-front readings, permits and delivery book before the shift. The forecast helps plan work but cannot clear a task.
01_pre_shift_planning.pain: Exposed trench work may clash with the 11:30 aggregate delivery. The civil and logistics plans have not yet been checked together.
01_pre_shift_planning.trustQuestion: Rashid and Huda need to brief the civil crew on the planned sequence, then check fresh local readings before exposed work starts.
01_pre_shift_planning.moneyQuestion: Amal should record any actual change to work or the delivery slot. Delay, standby or supplier charges need contract review only if they arise.
01_pre_shift_planning.coordinationNeed: Rashid reviews the trench sequence with Huda and Noura before the shift. Huda confirms the crew briefing; permits and local readings still control the work.

commercial.status: Planning risk only. No heat stop, charge or cost claim is recorded.
commercial.owner: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
items: Record a programme or booking change if one occurs
Check actual supplier or subcontractor charges against the relevant agreement

evidenceNeeded: Original work programme and 11:30 delivery booking
Forecast source and review time
Fresh local reading, permit and any approved change
01_pre_shift_planning.aiContribution: Show the forecast, trench task and delivery booking together for Rashid’s review; prepare a crew briefing draft for Huda.

02_heat_alert_response.existingProcess: The civil work-front monitor drives a local beacon. Under the site heat programme, Huda stops exposed heavy work, radios her crew and records the stop; Maya and Rashid oversee the hold.
02_heat_alert_response.pain: The beacon alone does not show whether the crew received the instruction, stopped work or reached recovery. Dune also needs a clear record of the time lost.
02_heat_alert_response.trustQuestion: Maya issues the site hold under Rashid’s authority. Huda must acknowledge it, stop the trench task, account for the affected workers and direct them to water and cooling.
02_heat_alert_response.moneyQuestion: Dune’s fictional Heat Rest Schedule covers required recovery during ordinary rostered time. Dune must verify individual payment; Amal separately reviews lost output and any later delay cost.
02_heat_alert_response.coordinationNeed: Maya records the local trigger and instruction. Huda confirms the actual stop and recovery count without waiting for a cost decision, and refers individual pay questions to Mina Rahman at Dune.
stakeholders: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager

commercial.status: Dune’s fictional ordinary-shift recovery term applies to the covered civil crew. Actual payroll and any payment between organisations are unverified.
commercial.owner: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
items: Huda explains the approved rest scope; Mina handles individual coverage and pay questions
Record Dune’s actual lost output or standby for later review
Review any programme cost under the parties’ agreements; no client allowance is agreed

evidenceNeeded: Civil work-front reading, quality, zone and time
Beacon and radio instruction times
Huda’s acknowledgment and actual stop time
Affected workers’ recovery count and location
Original task and programme
Fictional Heat Rest Schedule and covered roster
Dune payroll confirmation if later available
02_heat_alert_response.aiContribution: Link the alert to the instruction, acknowledgment, stop and recovery records; show Amal the unresolved cost item.

03_constrained_reassignment.existingProcess: During the civil trench hold, Huda and Rashid may review other tasks against qualifications and the occupancy board. Two welfare attendants already occupy the six-seat workshop.
03_constrained_reassignment.pain: Moving the whole civil crew would exceed workshop capacity and include people without the right assignment. Recovery places must stay available for workers who need them.
03_constrained_reassignment.trustQuestion: Huda must confirm recovery and suitability before assigning Rana, Yusuf, Dana and Bilal to lightweight workshop preparation. She keeps the other affected workers accounted for.
03_constrained_reassignment.moneyQuestion: Dune’s ordinary-shift recovery term still applies where covered. Amal needs actual workshop work and remaining standby times before reviewing any programme cost.
03_constrained_reassignment.coordinationNeed: Huda checks four available seats and the workers’ qualifications, then approves only the separate workshop task. Rashid keeps the trench hold in place.
stakeholders: Rana Al Nadir, Yusuf Al Wadi, Dana Al Qamar and Bilal Al Safa, civil workers
Lina Al Qamar and Omar Al Safa, workshop welfare attendants
Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager

commercial.status: Covered recovery time remains within Dune’s fictional ordinary-shift term. Any cost allocation between parties remains open.
commercial.owner: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
items: Record the four workers’ actual workshop work
Record remaining recovery and standby time
Dune confirms individual payroll through its employer process
Review any subcontract or client adjustment against the agreements

evidenceNeeded: Linked civil heat hold and stop record
Recovery and task suitability confirmation
Six-seat workshop capacity and current occupants
Qualifications and assignment times for Rana, Yusuf, Dana and Bilal
Locations of remaining affected workers
Heat Rest Schedule scope and later Dune payroll confirmation if available
03_constrained_reassignment.aiContribution: Explain why the whole-crew move fails capacity and qualification checks; offer the four-person task for Huda’s approval.

04_delivery_coordination.existingProcess: Noura maintains the delivery book and contacts the Oasis Aggregate Supply dispatcher. A new slot needs an approved request, a sent message and supplier acceptance.
04_delivery_coordination.pain: The civil hold changes yard capacity and puts the 11:30 aggregate booking at risk. Moving the booking may also create standby or transport costs.
04_delivery_coordination.trustQuestion: Noura must send the revised request and record the dispatcher’s reply. The 15:30 slot is confirmed only after supplier acceptance; the trench hold remains in place.
04_delivery_coordination.moneyQuestion: Amal reviews any actual supplier charge, civil delay or client milestone effect against the contracts. Agreement on a new time does not settle those costs.
04_delivery_coordination.coordinationNeed: Noura approves and sends the slot request, records the supplier’s acceptance and checks safe receiving conditions when the delivery arrives. Amal receives the open cost question.
stakeholders: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager

commercial.status: The connected replay can confirm a 15:30 supplier slot after acceptance. Charges, actual delivery and cost allocation remain unconfirmed.
commercial.owner: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
items: Keep Dune’s protected recovery term separate from supplier costs
Check supplier rescheduling or standby charges if invoiced
Record effects on the civil and yard sequence
Review any client milestone treatment under the client agreement

Civil hold and actual stop time
Noura’s approved request and send time
Supplier acceptance and revised booking
Actual delivery and any later charge or programme effect

04_delivery_coordination.aiContribution: Prepare Noura’s slot request and distinguish draft, sent and supplier-accepted states; send cost records to Amal for review.

05_restricted_worker_assignment.existingProcess: Huda checks the mobilisation roster and acclimatisation restrictions before civil assignments. Noor and Adil are on supervised light work.
05_restricted_worker_assignment.pain: Assigning the two new starters to heavy trench work would conflict with their current restriction and pressure them to accept unsuitable work.
05_restricted_worker_assignment.trustQuestion: Huda keeps Noor and Adil on supervised light tasks and explains the assignment limit without sharing personal health details with the crew.
05_restricted_worker_assignment.moneyQuestion: Rashid plans around the reduced heavy-work capacity. A roster restriction alone does not establish a wage adjustment or a claim.
05_restricted_worker_assignment.coordinationNeed: Huda rejects the heavy-work request, confirms the existing light tasks and tells Rashid if the programme needs another crew plan.
stakeholders: Noor Al Nadir and Adil Al Wadi, new civil workers

commercial.status: No cost allocation is decided; the assignment restriction still applies.
commercial.owner: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
items: Record any actual capacity shortfall for normal programme review

Approved supervised light tasks
Rejected heavy-task request and operational reason
05_restricted_worker_assignment.aiContribution: Show Huda the assignment restriction and available light work without exposing personal health records.

06_sensor_failure.existingProcess: The civil beacon uses the civil work-front monitor. Maya can arrange a manual local assessment if it fails; the electrical monitor covers a different zone.
06_sensor_failure.pain: The failed civil display leaves local conditions unverified. The electrical reading cannot show whether the trench is safe.
06_sensor_failure.trustQuestion: Maya tells Huda that the civil reading is unavailable and gives the crew the protective instruction while a local assessment is arranged.
06_sensor_failure.moneyQuestion: Amal records any actual hold or verification delay that affects the programme. A device failure alone establishes no payable delay.
06_sensor_failure.coordinationNeed: Maya logs the monitor failure, Huda follows the protective instruction and Rashid seeks a fresh verified civil-front assessment before restart review.
stakeholders: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager

commercial.status: No cost entitlement follows from the failed monitor or a precautionary hold.
commercial.owner: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
items: Record actual verification time and programme effect
Review any later cost under the relevant agreement

evidenceNeeded: Civil monitor failure and last valid reading time
Electrical monitor’s separate zone
Manual civil-front assessment request and result
Crew instruction and actual stop confirmation
06_sensor_failure.aiContribution: Flag the missing civil reading, reject the electrical reading as a substitute and list the checks Maya and Rashid need.

07_unacknowledged_alert.existingProcess: The local beacon and radio carry the civil hold instruction. The manual register expects Huda’s acknowledgment; Rashid handles escalation after the fictional two-minute window.
07_unacknowledged_alert.pain: The missing reply leaves the crew’s actual work status unknown. Radio congestion or a missed entry could explain it, so the stop cannot be marked complete.
07_unacknowledged_alert.trustQuestion: Rashid contacts Huda or checks the work front to establish what the crew heard and did, while keeping the hold open.
07_unacknowledged_alert.moneyQuestion: Amal needs verified acknowledgment and stop times before assessing any actual delay. Escalation itself creates no payable claim.
07_unacknowledged_alert.coordinationNeed: Rashid verifies receipt and task cessation directly. Maya keeps the instruction open until the foreman’s response and crew status are recorded.
stakeholders: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager

commercial.status: Work status and timing must be verified before any cost review.
commercial.owner: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
items: Reconcile beacon, radio, acknowledgment and actual stop times

evidenceNeeded: Beacon and alert times
Radio and register contact attempts
Rashid’s escalation time
Huda’s acknowledgment and observed stop if later confirmed
07_unacknowledged_alert.aiContribution: Flag the missing acknowledgment and ask Rashid to verify the crew’s status without assuming the stop is complete.

08_symptom_escalation.existingProcess: A worker may report symptoms to Huda or trained first aider Salim regardless of the local heat band. Salim keeps clinical details in the first-aid record.
08_symptom_escalation.pain: Bilal may delay reporting symptoms because he fears disrupting the crew. A non-hold environmental reading cannot rule out individual harm.
08_symptom_escalation.trustQuestion: Huda removes Bilal from the task and contacts Salim promptly. The shared crew record contains only the operational restriction and response status.
08_symptom_escalation.moneyQuestion: Dune handles any individual pay or absence question through its employer process. The site record does not determine wages or leave.
08_symptom_escalation.coordinationNeed: Huda releases Bilal from work and contacts Salim. Salim assesses or refers him privately and gives Huda only the task restriction she needs.

commercial.status: The shared record contains no individual wage or cost decision.
commercial.owner: Mina Rahman, Dune contract manager, for employer pay questions; Amal Al Nadir for programme effects
items: Keep individual employment and clinical details out of the shared crew log

evidenceNeeded: Symptom report time
Removal from task and contact with Salim
First-aid response status without clinical detail in the shared record
08_symptom_escalation.aiContribution: Prompt Huda to contact Salim and keep the symptom response separate from the environmental threshold.

09_restart_review.existingProcess: Rashid and permit coordinator Tariq review the permit, local monitor and crew conditions before any restart. An improved beacon band is one input.
09_restart_review.pain: The reading may improve and then become stale while the crew is waiting. Earlier approval cannot carry into changed or unverified conditions.
09_restart_review.trustQuestion: Rashid authorises restart only after Tariq confirms the permit and both check a current local reading, crew readiness and welfare conditions. A stale reading blocks a later attempt.
09_restart_review.moneyQuestion: Amal reconciles actual hold and restart times if the programme changes. A delayed restart does not by itself establish a payable claim.
09_restart_review.coordinationNeed: Rashid reviews the current civil-front reading with Tariq and Huda at the proposed restart time. A later stale or failed reading requires a new check.
stakeholders: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager

commercial.status: No cost allocation or payable delay is established by restart timing alone.
commercial.owner: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
items: Reconcile actual hold and restart times if programme review is needed

evidenceNeeded: Current civil-front reading and monitor health
Tariq’s permit check and Rashid’s decision
Crew, water and recovery readiness
Restart time and any later stale-reading time
09_restart_review.aiContribution: List the current restart checks and missing evidence for Tariq and Rashid; leave authorisation with Rashid.

10_handover_and_evidence.existingProcess: Rashid hands the heat register, permit status and delivery book to the next supervisor. The same civil heat event carries through the stop, reassignment and supplier coordination.
10_handover_and_evidence.pain: A short handover could omit the held trench, seven workers still in recovery, the four-person workshop task, or the difference between a revised booking and an actual delivery.
10_handover_and_evidence.trustQuestion: Rashid gives the next supervisor the verified instruction, stop, recovery and task states, plus the checks still needed before trench work restarts.
10_handover_and_evidence.moneyQuestion: Dune’s fictional ordinary-shift recovery term applies where covered, but actual payroll is unverified. Amal reviews lost output, supplier charges and any client treatment against the contracts.
10_handover_and_evidence.coordinationNeed: Rashid hands over the current safety state and source times. Noura verifies delivery status; Amal receives the separate unresolved cost question.
stakeholders: Amal Al Nadir, Sandline project manager
